# package shape

`import "example.com/basic/shape"`

<a name="pkg-overview"></a>
## Overview

Package shape defines shapes.

A [Circle](<#Circle>) wraps an [io.Reader](<https://pkg.go.dev/io#Reader>), never a bytes.Buffer. The root type [basic.Config](<basic.md#Config>)
and the constant basic.Version live elsewhere. Markdown-looking text: \*bold\*,
\_x\_, \<nil\>, \&amp;, \~/path, a \| b, \$HOME and the numbered line
1999\. was a good year.
